inlet.source: Boltzmann 100-point EEDF neutral mixture; mole fractions preserved, translated to MOOSE mass fractions

warning: Research-only oxygen ICP 25-channel effective-O(ex) model: EI936 restored with optional lookup or Gudmundsson Maxwellian analytic fallback; O(1S) and O(1D) lumped into Os, independent 4.19 eV loss; EI413/414 O2a lump, chosen dissociation/H23-H25; physics validity is not established.

initial_conditions.charged_seed_policy: preserve previously specified research seed; charge-neutral
initial_conditions.neutral_bulk_initialization_policy: initialize O2(a1Delta), O(3P), O(1D) to number fraction 1e-5 each; O2(X) is the residual 0.99997; convert to MOOSE neutral mass fractions

chemistry.convention: Preserve original 25-row physical provenance. In this 400/1000W reduced model, products of EI935 O(1D) and EI936 O(1S) are mapped into a common O(ex)/Os species. Rates remain separate; electron energy losses 1.97 and 4.19 eV, respectively. No independent O(1S) transport or reverse process.

effective_dissociation_choices.meaning: Treat each as e+parent -> e+2O(3P); separate rates, no double use of same progress
effective_dissociation_choices.electron_energy_policy: Preserve each channel-specific tabulated/model loss; 411/2068 are effective, not exact dissociation thermochemistry
effective_dissociation_choices.scientific_verification: not required as gate for this exploratory run

dissociation_double_count_guard.legacy_Zhao_DISS_G: disable in this research case when the 411+412 lookup projections are connected
dissociation_double_count_guard.caveat: The two independent source terms are not intrinsically duplicate; only parallel legacy formula for same channels would double count

ei936.rate_policy: Use independent validated 100-point lookup if present; otherwise use Gudmundsson et al. (2000) Table 3 analytic Maxwellian fit
